description: Permafrost - Ivvavik is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. This dataset measures the temperature of the soil at 4 depths: 1 meter, 5 meters, 10 meters and 14 meters. This permafrost data is collected using Hobodata loggers that collect data at 12 hour intervals throughout the year. Field maintenance and station updates occur annually in late March and early April. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Parks Canada | Parcs Canada. Its tags are Ivvavik, pergélisol, Arctique, changement climatique, sol. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2024-12-09 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
